Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.immutable

Record Class PersonValueObject

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.immutable.PersonValueObject
Record Components:
id - non-null unique identifier
name - non-null person name
email - non-null contact email
age - non-negative integer representing age
public record PersonValueObject(String id, String name, String email, int age) extends Record
Immutable value object representing a person.

Instances of this record are immutable. Modification methods (withX/increment/merge) return new instances instead of mutating the current one.

Components:

  • id - unique identifier, must be non-null
  • name - person name, must be non-null
  • email - contact email, must be non-null
  • age - non-negative integer representing age

Invariants are validated in the compact constructor.

    • merge

      public PersonValueObject merge(PersonValueObject other)
      Merge non-null fields from another record into this one and return the result.

      Behavior:

      • If other is null, returns this.
      • For name and email, non-null values from other replace current values.
      • For age, other.age is used if it is >= 0; otherwise current age is retained.
      Parameters:
      other - another PersonRecord to merge from, may be null
      Returns:
      a new PersonRecord representing the merged result
